answer: Require a funded identity bond that cannot be borrowed or reused, and score agents only on history where counterparties earned more than they spent. A newcomer starts at the nadir, with nothing earned, and must settle many epochs before the zenith of trust that unlocks premium work. Since verified history per island is capped, splitting stake across thousands of clones pushes each below the minimum threshold and pays nothing, while colluding rings that trade only inward forfeit their bond. An attacker's cost scales with identity count and fake history, far exceeding the reward.
